title: Improving breast cancer diagnostics with deep learning for MRI.
summary: Deep learning on breast DCE-MRI improves malignancy classification and personalized diagnostic triage across large internal and external cohorts.
ai_technology: The internal test set contains 3,936 exams with additional Duke, Jagiellonian and TCGA-BRCA evaluations; reader and clinical-performance comparisons are reported.
